  // Get all mobile menu items

    item.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      
      const isCurrentlyActive = this.classList.contains('active');
      const nextAccordion = this.nextElementSibling;
      
      // Remove 'active' class from all menu items
      menuItems.forEach(mi => mi.classList.remove('active'));
      
      // Close all accordion content wrappers
      const allContentWrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-content-wrapper');
      allContentWrappers.forEach(wrapper => {
        wrapper.style.display = 'none';
      });
      
      // Hide all mobile menu accordions
      const allAccordions = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-accordion');
      allAccordions.forEach(accordion => {
        accordion.style.display = 'none';
        accordion.classList.remove('active');
      });
      
      // If it wasn't active, activate it and show accordion
      if (!isCurrentlyActive) {
        this.classList.add('active');
        
        // Show the next sibling mobile-menu-accordion
        if (nextAccordion && nextAccordion.classList.contains('mobile-menu-accordion')) {
          nextAccordion.style.display = 'flex';
          nextAccordion.classList.add('active');
        }
      }
      // If it was already active, everything is now closed (done above)
    });
  });
  
  // Handle accordion title clicks inside the menu
  const accordionTitles = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-accordion .accordion-title-wrapper');
  
  accordionTitles.forEach(title => {
    title.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent event bubbling
      
      const parentAccordion = this.closest('.mobile-menu-accordion');
      const contentWrapper = this.nextElementSibling;
      
      if (!contentWrapper || !contentWrapper.classList.contains('accordion-content-wrapper')) {
        return;
      }
      
      const isCurrentlyOpen = contentWrapper.style.display === 'block';
      
      // Close all accordion content wrappers within this mobile-menu-accordion
      if (parentAccordion) {
        const allContentInAccordion = parentAccordion.querySelectorAll('.accordion-content-wrapper');
        allContentInAccordion.forEach(wrapper => {
          wrapper.style.display = 'none';
        });
      }
      
      // Toggle: if it was closed, open it; if it was open, keep it closed
      if (!isCurrentlyOpen) {
        contentWrapper.style.display = 'block';
      }
    });

 * Auto-cycles through .tab-title elements like a carousel,
 * starting only when the container enters the viewport,
 * and stopping permanently once the user manually interacts.
 *
 * Requires: gsap + ScrollTrigger plugin loaded on the page.
 *
 * @param {string|Element} containerSelector - wrapper containing the tab-title elements
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {number} options.interval - ms between tab switches (default 4000)
 * @param {string} options.tabSelector - selector for tab items (default '.tab-title')
 * @param {string} options.activeClass - class considered "active" (default 'tab-title--active')
 * @param {boolean} options.pauseOnHover - pause rotation on hover (default true)
 * @param {boolean} options.once - only trigger once when entering view (default true)
 */
function initTabCarousel(containerSelector, options = {}) {
  const {
    interval = 4000,
    tabSelector = '.tab-title',
    activeClass = 'tab-title--active',
    pauseOnHover = true,
    once = true,
  } = options;

  const container = typeof containerSelector === 'string'
    ? document.querySelector(containerSelector)
    : containerSelector;

  if (!container) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: container not found', containerSelector);
    return;
  }

  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  const tabs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(tabSelector));
  if (!tabs.length) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: no tab-title elements found');
    return;
  }

  let currentIndex = tabs.findIndex((t) => t.classList.contains(activeClass));
  if (currentIndex === -1) currentIndex = 0;

  let timer = null;
  let isPaused = false;
  let userInteracted = false;
  let isAutoClicking = false; // guards against our own .click() calls counting as "interaction"

  const advance = () => {
    if (isPaused || userInteracted) return;
    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % tabs.length;
    isAutoClicking = true;
    tabs[currentIndex].click();
    isAutoClicking = false;
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (timer || userInteracted) return;
    timer = setInterval(advance, interval);
  };

  const stop = () => {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = null;
  };

  const stopPermanently = () => {
    userInteracted = true;
    stop();
  };

  if (pauseOnHover) {
    container.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { isPaused = true; });
    container.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isPaused = false; });
  }

  // Detect manual interaction: click or keyboard activation on a tab
  tabs.forEach((tab) => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!isAutoClicking) stopPermanently();
    });
    tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') stopPermanently();
    });
  });

  // Also catch touch interaction (some mobile UIs fire touchstart before click)
  container.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
    stopPermanently();
  }, { passive: true, once: true });

    trigger: container,
    start: 'top 80%',
    end: 'bottom 20%',
    onEnter: start,
    onEnterBack: once ? undefined : start,
    onLeave: once ? undefined : stop,
    onLeaveBack: once ? undefined : stop,
    once,
  });

  return { stop, start, get userInteracted() { return userInteracted; } };
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  
  // Get all mobile menu items
  const menuItems = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-item');
  
  menuItems.forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      
      const isCurrentlyActive = this.classList.contains('active');
      const nextAccordion = this.nextElementSibling;
      
      // Remove 'active' class from all menu items
      menuItems.forEach(mi => mi.classList.remove('active'));
      
      // Close all accordion content wrappers
      const allContentWrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-content-wrapper');
      allContentWrappers.forEach(wrapper => {
        wrapper.style.display = 'none';
      });
      
      // Hide all mobile menu accordions
      const allAccordions = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-accordion');
      allAccordions.forEach(accordion => {
        accordion.style.display = 'none';
        accordion.classList.remove('active');
      });
      
      // If it wasn't active, activate it and show accordion
      if (!isCurrentlyActive) {
        this.classList.add('active');
        
        // Show the next sibling mobile-menu-accordion
        if (nextAccordion && nextAccordion.classList.contains('mobile-menu-accordion')) {
          nextAccordion.style.display = 'flex';
          nextAccordion.classList.add('active');
        }
      }
      // If it was already active, everything is now closed (done above)
    });
  });
  
  // Handle accordion title clicks inside the menu
  const accordionTitles = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-accordion .accordion-title-wrapper');
  
  accordionTitles.forEach(title => {
    title.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent event bubbling
      
      const parentAccordion = this.closest('.mobile-menu-accordion');
      const contentWrapper = this.nextElementSibling;
      
      if (!contentWrapper || !contentWrapper.classList.contains('accordion-content-wrapper')) {
        return;
      }
      
      const isCurrentlyOpen = contentWrapper.style.display === 'block';
      
      // Close all accordion content wrappers within this mobile-menu-accordion
      if (parentAccordion) {
        const allContentInAccordion = parentAccordion.querySelectorAll('.accordion-content-wrapper');
        allContentInAccordion.forEach(wrapper => {
          wrapper.style.display = 'none';
        });
      }
      
      // Toggle: if it was closed, open it; if it was open, keep it closed
      if (!isCurrentlyOpen) {
        contentWrapper.style.display = 'block';
      }
    });
  });

 * Auto-cycles through .tab-title elements like a carousel,
 * starting only when the container enters the viewport,
 * and stopping permanently once the user manually interacts.
 *
 * Requires: gsap + ScrollTrigger plugin loaded on the page.
 *
 * @param {string|Element} containerSelector - wrapper containing the tab-title elements
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {number} options.interval - ms between tab switches (default 4000)
 * @param {string} options.tabSelector - selector for tab items (default '.tab-title')
 * @param {string} options.activeClass - class considered "active" (default 'tab-title--active')
 * @param {boolean} options.pauseOnHover - pause rotation on hover (default true)
 * @param {boolean} options.once - only trigger once when entering view (default true)
 */
function initTabCarousel(containerSelector, options = {}) {
  const {
    interval = 4000,
    tabSelector = '.tab-title',
    activeClass = 'tab-title--active',
    pauseOnHover = true,
    once = true,
  } = options;

  const container = typeof containerSelector === 'string'
    ? document.querySelector(containerSelector)
    : containerSelector;

  if (!container) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: container not found', containerSelector);
    return;
  }

  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  const tabs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(tabSelector));
  if (!tabs.length) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: no tab-title elements found');
    return;
  }

  let currentIndex = tabs.findIndex((t) => t.classList.contains(activeClass));
  if (currentIndex === -1) currentIndex = 0;

  let timer = null;
  let isPaused = false;
  let userInteracted = false;
  let isAutoClicking = false; // guards against our own .click() calls counting as "interaction"

  const advance = () => {
    if (isPaused || userInteracted) return;
    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % tabs.length;
    isAutoClicking = true;
    tabs[currentIndex].click();
    isAutoClicking = false;
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (timer || userInteracted) return;
    timer = setInterval(advance, interval);
  };

  const stop = () => {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = null;
  };

  const stopPermanently = () => {
    userInteracted = true;
    stop();
  };

  if (pauseOnHover) {
    container.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { isPaused = true; });
    container.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isPaused = false; });
  }

  // Detect manual interaction: click or keyboard activation on a tab
  tabs.forEach((tab) => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!isAutoClicking) stopPermanently();
    });
    tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') stopPermanently();
    });
  });

  // Also catch touch interaction (some mobile UIs fire touchstart before click)
  container.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
    stopPermanently();
  }, { passive: true, once: true });

    trigger: container,
    start: 'top 80%',
    end: 'bottom 20%',
    onEnter: start,
    onEnterBack: once ? undefined : start,
    onLeave: once ? undefined : stop,
    onLeaveBack: once ? undefined : stop,
    once,
  });

  return { stop, start, get userInteracted() { return userInteracted; } };
}

      // Remove 'active' class from all menu items
      menuItems.forEach(mi => mi.classList.remove('active'));
      
      // Close all accordion content wrappers
      const allContentWrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-content-wrapper');
      allContentWrappers.forEach(wrapper => {
        wrapper.style.display = 'none';
      });
      
      // Hide all mobile menu accordions
      const allAccordions = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-accordion');
      allAccordions.forEach(accordion => {
        accordion.style.display = 'none';
        accordion.classList.remove('active');
      });
      
      // If it wasn't active, activate it and show accordion
      if (!isCurrentlyActive) {
        this.classList.add('active');
        
        // Show the next sibling mobile-menu-accordion

          nextAccordion.style.display = 'flex';
          nextAccordion.classList.add('active');
        }
      }
      // If it was already active, everything is now closed (done above)
    });
  });
  
  // Handle accordion title clicks inside the menu
  const accordionTitles = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-accordion .accordion-title-wrapper');

      e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent event bubbling
      
      const parentAccordion = this.closest('.mobile-menu-accordion');
      const contentWrapper = this.nextElementSibling;
      
      if (!contentWrapper || !contentWrapper.classList.contains('accordion-content-wrapper')) {
        return;

      // Close all accordion content wrappers within this mobile-menu-accordion
      if (parentAccordion) {
        const allContentInAccordion = parentAccordion.querySelectorAll('.accordion-content-wrapper');
        allContentInAccordion.forEach(wrapper => {
          wrapper.style.display = 'none';
        });
      }
      
      // Toggle: if it was closed, open it; if it was open, keep it closed
      if (!isCurrentlyOpen) {
        contentWrapper.style.display = 'block';
      }

 * Auto-cycles through .tab-title elements like a carousel,
 * starting only when the container enters the viewport,
 * and stopping permanently once the user manually interacts.
 *
 * Requires: gsap + ScrollTrigger plugin loaded on the page.
 *
 * @param {string|Element} containerSelector - wrapper containing the tab-title elements
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {number} options.interval - ms between tab switches (default 4000)
 * @param {string} options.tabSelector - selector for tab items (default '.tab-title')
 * @param {string} options.activeClass - class considered "active" (default 'tab-title--active')
 * @param {boolean} options.pauseOnHover - pause rotation on hover (default true)
 * @param {boolean} options.once - only trigger once when entering view (default true)
 */
function initTabCarousel(containerSelector, options = {}) {
  const {
    interval = 4000,
    tabSelector = '.tab-title',
    activeClass = 'tab-title--active',
    pauseOnHover = true,
    once = true,
  } = options;

  const container = typeof containerSelector === 'string'
    ? document.querySelector(containerSelector)
    : containerSelector;

  if (!container) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: container not found', containerSelector);
    return;
  }

  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  const tabs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(tabSelector));
  if (!tabs.length) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: no tab-title elements found');
    return;
  }

Brands across retail, media and entertainment, finance and insurance, travel and hospitality, sports and telecom rely on Airship to drive retention, sustained loyalty and higher customer lifetime value.</span></p></div></div></div><div class="brxe-aroajf brxe-block" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><div class="brxe-pyxwwr brxe-block accordion-title-wrapper" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0" aria-controls="faq-item-04"><h4 class="brxe-hrfzaz brxe-heading" itemprop="name" id="">What is a customer experience platform?</h4><div class="brxe-vyhmdq brxe-block"><svg class="brxe-utpkqs brxe-icon brxi-ipsnul brx-icon-transform" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="13" height="13" viewbox="0 0 13 13" fill="none"><path d="M0.5 6.33333L12.1667 6.33333M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 0.5M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 12.1667" stroke="#000818" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></div><div id="faq-item-04" class="brxe-iznguw brxe-block accordion-content-wrapper" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer" role="region" aria-labelledby=""><div class="brxe-epjzqp brxe-text" itemprop="text"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">A customer experience platform helps brands create, manage, measure and optimize unified, hyper-personalized experiences that drive conversions in the app and on the web. Mobile sits at the center of that ecosystem, where app, web, email, push, SMS/RCS and mobile wallet all converge. As customer experiences grow more fragmented, a mobile-first platform is what holds them together.</span></p></div></div></div><div class="brxe-aroajf brxe-block" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><div class="brxe-pyxwwr brxe-block accordion-title-wrapper" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0" aria-controls="faq-item-05"><h4 class="brxe-hrfzaz brxe-heading" itemprop="name" id="">What is the difference between a CRM and a customer engagement platform?</h4><div class="brxe-vyhmdq brxe-block"><svg class="brxe-utpkqs brxe-icon brxi-fchhpy brx-icon-transform" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="13" height="13" viewbox="0 0 13 13" fill="none"><path d="M0.5 6.33333L12.1667 6.33333M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 0.5M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 12.1667" stroke="#000818" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></div><div id="faq-item-05" class="brxe-iznguw brxe-block accordion-content-wrapper" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer" role="region" aria-labelledby=""><div class="brxe-epjzqp brxe-text" itemprop="text"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">CRM platforms manage a company’s records and relationships across existing and future customers. Customer engagement platforms create the experiences themselves: the cross-channel interactions that build loyalty and advocacy. The two work together in most enterprise stacks, with Airship activating CRM data across every channel so what a brand knows about a customer shapes what that customer experiences next.</span></p></div></div></div><div class="brxe-aroajf brxe-block" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><div class="brxe-pyxwwr brxe-block accordion-title-wrapper" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0" aria-controls="faq-item-06"><h4 class="brxe-hrfzaz brxe-heading" itemprop="name" id="">Does Airship integrate with other marketing tools and platforms?</h4><div class="brxe-vyhmdq brxe-block"><svg class="brxe-utpkqs brxe-icon brxi-frsvnv brx-icon-transform" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="13" height="13" viewbox="0 0 13 13" fill="none"><path d="M0.5 6.33333L12.1667 6.33333M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 0.5M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 12.1667" stroke="#000818" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></div><div id="faq-item-06" class="brxe-iznguw brxe-block accordion-content-wrapper" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer" role="region" aria-labelledby=""><div class="brxe-epjzqp brxe-text" itemprop="text"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Airship integrates with a broad set of <a href="/capabilities/integrations/">enterprise marketing, data and analytics platforms</a> — CDPs, CRMs, cloud data warehouses, personalization tools and analytics systems — so customer data and behavioral signals flow into Airship for activation and back out for measurement.  * Auto-cycles through .tab-title elements like a carousel,
 * starting only when the container enters the viewport,
 * and stopping permanently once the user manually interacts.
 *
 * Requires: gsap + ScrollTrigger plugin loaded on the page.
 *
 * @param {string|Element} containerSelector - wrapper containing the tab-title elements
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {number} options.interval - ms between tab switches (default 4000)
 * @param {string} options.tabSelector - selector for tab items (default '.tab-title')
 * @param {string} options.activeClass - class considered "active" (default 'tab-title--active')
 * @param {boolean} options.pauseOnHover - pause rotation on hover (default true)
 * @param {boolean} options.once - only trigger once when entering view (default true)
 */
function initTabCarousel(containerSelector, options = {}) {
  const {
    interval = 4000,
    tabSelector = '.tab-title',
    activeClass = 'tab-title--active',
    pauseOnHover = true,
    once = true,
  } = options;

  const container = typeof containerSelector === 'string'
    ? document.querySelector(containerSelector)
    : containerSelector;

  if (!container) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: container not found', containerSelector);
    return;
  }

  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  const tabs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(tabSelector));
  if (!tabs.length) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: no tab-title elements found');
    return;
  }

  let currentIndex = tabs.findIndex((t) => t.classList.contains(activeClass));
  if (currentIndex === -1) currentIndex = 0;

  let timer = null;
  let isPaused = false;
  let userInteracted = false;
  let isAutoClicking = false; // guards against our own .click() calls counting as "interaction"

  const advance = () => {
    if (isPaused || userInteracted) return;
    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % tabs.length;
    isAutoClicking = true;
    tabs[currentIndex].click();
    isAutoClicking = false;
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (timer || userInteracted) return;
    timer = setInterval(advance, interval);
  };

  const stop = () => {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = null;
  };

  const stopPermanently = () => {
    userInteracted = true;
    stop();
  };

  if (pauseOnHover) {
    container.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { isPaused = true; });
    container.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isPaused = false; });
  }

  // Detect manual interaction: click or keyboard activation on a tab
  tabs.forEach((tab) => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!isAutoClicking) stopPermanently();
    });
    tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') stopPermanently();
    });
  });

  // Also catch touch interaction (some mobile UIs fire touchstart before click)
  container.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
    stopPermanently();
  }, { passive: true, once: true });

  ScrollTrigger.create({
    trigger: container,
    start: 'top 80%',
    end: 'bottom 20%',
    onEnter: start,
    onEnterBack: once ? undefined : start,
    onLeave: once ? undefined : stop,
    onLeaveBack: once ? undefined : stop,
    once,
  });

  return { stop, start, get userInteracted() { return userInteracted; } };
}

  // Get all mobile menu items

    item.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      
      const isCurrentlyActive = this.classList.contains('active');
      const nextAccordion = this.nextElementSibling;
      
      // Remove 'active' class from all menu items
      menuItems.forEach(mi => mi.classList.remove('active'));
      
      // Close all accordion content wrappers
      const allContentWrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-content-wrapper');
      allContentWrappers.forEach(wrapper => {
        wrapper.style.display = 'none';
      });
      
      // Hide all mobile menu accordions
      const allAccordions = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-accordion');
      allAccordions.forEach(accordion => {
        accordion.style.display = 'none';
        accordion.classList.remove('active');
      });
      
      // If it wasn't active, activate it and show accordion
      if (!isCurrentlyActive) {
        this.classList.add('active');
        
        // Show the next sibling mobile-menu-accordion
        if (nextAccordion && nextAccordion.classList.contains('mobile-menu-accordion')) {
          nextAccordion.style.display = 'flex';
          nextAccordion.classList.add('active');
        }
      }
      // If it was already active, everything is now closed (done above)
    });
  });
  
  // Handle accordion title clicks inside the menu
  const accordionTitles = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-accordion .accordion-title-wrapper');
  
  accordionTitles.forEach(title => {
    title.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent event bubbling
      
      const parentAccordion = this.closest('.mobile-menu-accordion');
      const contentWrapper = this.nextElementSibling;
      
      if (!contentWrapper || !contentWrapper.classList.contains('accordion-content-wrapper')) {
        return;
      }
      
      const isCurrentlyOpen = contentWrapper.style.display === 'block';
      
      // Close all accordion content wrappers within this mobile-menu-accordion
      if (parentAccordion) {
        const allContentInAccordion = parentAccordion.querySelectorAll('.accordion-content-wrapper');
        allContentInAccordion.forEach(wrapper => {
          wrapper.style.display = 'none';
        });
      }
      
      // Toggle: if it was closed, open it; if it was open, keep it closed
      if (!isCurrentlyOpen) {
        contentWrapper.style.display = 'block';
      }
    });
  });

 * Auto-cycles through .tab-title elements like a carousel,
 * starting only when the container enters the viewport,
 * and stopping permanently once the user manually interacts.
 *
 * Requires: gsap + ScrollTrigger plugin loaded on the page.
 *
 * @param {string|Element} containerSelector - wrapper containing the tab-title elements
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {number} options.interval - ms between tab switches (default 4000)
 * @param {string} options.tabSelector - selector for tab items (default '.tab-title')
 * @param {string} options.activeClass - class considered "active" (default 'tab-title--active')
 * @param {boolean} options.pauseOnHover - pause rotation on hover (default true)
 * @param {boolean} options.once - only trigger once when entering view (default true)
 */
function initTabCarousel(containerSelector, options = {}) {
  const {
    interval = 4000,
    tabSelector = '.tab-title',
    activeClass = 'tab-title--active',
    pauseOnHover = true,
    once = true,
  } = options;

  const container = typeof containerSelector === 'string'
    ? document.querySelector(containerSelector)
    : containerSelector;

  if (!container) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: container not found', containerSelector);
    return;
  }

  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  const tabs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(tabSelector));
  if (!tabs.length) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: no tab-title elements found');
    return;
  }

  let currentIndex = tabs.findIndex((t) => t.classList.contains(activeClass));
  if (currentIndex === -1) currentIndex = 0;

  let timer = null;
  let isPaused = false;
  let userInteracted = false;
  let isAutoClicking = false; // guards against our own .click() calls counting as "interaction"

  const advance = () => {
    if (isPaused || userInteracted) return;
    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % tabs.length;
    isAutoClicking = true;
    tabs[currentIndex].click();
    isAutoClicking = false;
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (timer || userInteracted) return;
    timer = setInterval(advance, interval);
  };

  const stop = () => {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = null;
  };

  const stopPermanently = () => {
    userInteracted = true;
    stop();
  };

  if (pauseOnHover) {
    container.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { isPaused = true; });
    container.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isPaused = false; });
  }

  // Detect manual interaction: click or keyboard activation on a tab
  tabs.forEach((tab) => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!isAutoClicking) stopPermanently();
    });
    tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') stopPermanently();
    });
  });

  // Also catch touch interaction (some mobile UIs fire touchstart before click)
  container.addEventListener('touchstart', () => {
    stopPermanently();
  }, { passive: true, once: true });

  ScrollTrigger.create({
    trigger: container,
    start: 'top 80%',
    end: 'bottom 20%',
    onEnter: start,
    onEnterBack: once ? undefined : start,
    onLeave: once ? undefined : stop,
    onLeaveBack: once ? undefined : stop,
    once,
  });

  return { stop, start, get userInteracted() { return userInteracted; } };
}

The two work together in most enterprise stacks, with Airship activating CRM data across every channel so what a brand knows about a customer shapes what that customer experiences next.</span></p></div></div></div><div class="brxe-aroajf brxe-block" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><div class="brxe-pyxwwr brxe-block accordion-title-wrapper" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0" aria-controls="faq-item-06"><h4 class="brxe-hrfzaz brxe-heading" itemprop="name" id="">Does Airship integrate with other marketing tools and platforms?</h4><div class="brxe-vyhmdq brxe-block"><svg class="brxe-utpkqs brxe-icon brxi-frsvnv brx-icon-transform" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="13" height="13" viewbox="0 0 13 13" fill="none"><path d="M0.5 6.33333L12.1667 6.33333M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 0.5M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 12.1667" stroke="#000818" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></div><div id="faq-item-06" class="brxe-iznguw brxe-block accordion-content-wrapper" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer" role="region" aria-labelledby=""><div class="brxe-epjzqp brxe-text" itemprop="text"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Airship integrates with a broad set of <a href="/capabilities/integrations/">enterprise marketing, data and analytics platforms</a> — CDPs, CRMs, cloud data warehouses, personalization tools and analytics systems — so customer data and behavioral signals flow into Airship for activation and back out for measurement. Those real-time, bi-directional flows power personalized push, in-app messages, email, SMS, wallet passes and app experiences inside the stack you already run.</span></p></div></div></div><div class="brxe-aroajf brxe-block" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><div class="brxe-pyxwwr brxe-block accordion-title-wrapper" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0" aria-controls="faq-item-07"><h4 class="brxe-hrfzaz brxe-heading" itemprop="name" id="">How does Airship ensure data security, privacy and compliance?</h4><div class="brxe-vyhmdq brxe-block"><svg class="brxe-utpkqs brxe-icon brxi-wlnogx brx-icon-transform" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="13" height="13" viewbox="0 0 13 13" fill="none"><path d="M0.5 6.33333L12.1667 6.33333M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 0.5M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 12.1667" stroke="#000818" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></div><div id="faq-item-07" class="brxe-iznguw brxe-block accordion-content-wrapper" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer" role="region" aria-labelledby=""><div class="brxe-epjzqp brxe-text" itemprop="text"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="/legal/trust-center/">Standard security measures</a> across the Airship platform include SOC 2 Type II, end-to-end encryption, and multi-factor authentication single sign-on (MFA/SSO) with role-based access control (RBAC). Integrity is one of Airship’s core values, and customer data is protected across every Airship operating environment. The platform also supports GDPR, CCPA/CPRA and the growing set of US state privacy laws.</span></p></div></div></div><div class="brxe-aroajf brxe-block" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><div class="brxe-pyxwwr brxe-block accordion-title-wrapper" role="button" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0" aria-controls="faq-item-08"><h4 class="brxe-hrfzaz brxe-heading" itemprop="name" id="">How easy is it to get started with Airship?</h4><div class="brxe-vyhmdq brxe-block"><svg class="brxe-utpkqs brxe-icon brxi-kpejqe brx-icon-transform" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="13" height="13" viewbox="0 0 13 13" fill="none"><path d="M0.5 6.33333L12.1667 6.33333M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 0.5M12.1667 6.33333L6.33333 12.1667" stroke="#000818" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></div><div id="faq-item-08" class="brxe-iznguw brxe-block accordion-content-wrapper" itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer" role="region" aria-labelledby=""><div class="brxe-epjzqp brxe-text" itemprop="text"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Airship onboarding starts with a <a href="/meeting-request/">live demo</a>, where you can see how mobile-first experiences drive value for your customers and revenue for your brand.  *

 * @param {Object} options

 * @param {string} options.tabSelector - selector for tab items (default '.tab-title')
 * @param {string} options.activeClass - class considered "active" (default 'tab-title--active')
 * @param {boolean} options.pauseOnHover - pause rotation on hover (default true)
 * @param {boolean} options.once - only trigger once when entering view (default true)
 */
function initTabCarousel(containerSelector, options = {}) {
  const {
    interval = 4000,
    tabSelector = '.tab-title',
    activeClass = 'tab-title--active',
    pauseOnHover = true,
    once = true,
  } = options;

  const container = typeof containerSelector === 'string'
    ? document.querySelector(containerSelector)
    : containerSelector;

  if (!container) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: container not found', containerSelector);
    return;
  }

  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  const tabs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(tabSelector));
  if (!tabs.length) {
    console.warn('initTabCarousel: no tab-title elements found');
    return;
  }

  let currentIndex = tabs.findIndex((t) => t.classList.contains(activeClass));
  if (currentIndex === -1) currentIndex = 0;

  let timer = null;
  let isPaused = false;
  let userInteracted = false;
  let isAutoClicking = false; // guards against our own .click() calls counting as "interaction"

  const advance = () => {
    if (isPaused || userInteracted) return;
    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % tabs.length;
    isAutoClicking = true;
    tabs[currentIndex].click();
    isAutoClicking = false;
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (timer || userInteracted) return;
    timer = setInterval(advance, interval);
  };

  const stop = () => {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = null;
  };

  const stopPermanently = () => {
    userInteracted = true;
    stop();
  };

  if (pauseOnHover) {
    container.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { isPaused = true; });
    container.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isPaused = false; });

  tabs.forEach((tab) => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!isAutoClicking) stopPermanently();

    tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {

    });

    onLeave: once ? undefined : stop,
    onLeaveBack: once ? undefined : stop,
    once,
  });
